setup.title: Welcome to CD Connector
setup.subtitle: Create a new local vault or generate a database from an existing JSON backup.
setup.modeA_desc: Maximum security. Derives an encryption key (Argon2id + AES-256-GCM) kept only in memory. Required on startup and allows exporting encrypted credentials.
setup.modeB_desc: No password prompt on startup. Generates a local random key to encrypt the database. Exports omit all passwords and private keys for safety.
setup.password_short: Password must be at least 4 characters.

setup.import_password_required: Enter the master password used when exporting the file.
setup.reuse_password: Use the same master password for this installation
setup.new_vault_mode: Security mode for this new database
